_comment: MIT fork of nn-home-com/farming-simulator-25-egg. Contains scripts only, no game files or license keys.
name: FS25 - Stepan Valic
author: stepanvalic@users.noreply.github.com
description: FS25 dedicated server under WineHQ. Persistent GIANTS panel settings. Manual installer by default; optional cached one-time portal request. Separate licensed copy required.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/installer /mnt/server/dlc /mnt/server/data/mods
echo "Upload your licensed installer to installer/. Set WEB_PASSWORD and first-install GAME_SERIAL before starting. See repository README."

variables.name: CD-Key / Serial
variables.description: Your FS25 server CD-key. Used on first boot to download your copy from the official GIANTS portal and to generate the license files. Leave empty only if you upload the installer AND pre-activated *.dat files manually.

variables.name: Auto-download game
variables.description: Opt-in: one portal POST per persistent data directory. Cached response reused. Failed requests are not automatically repeated.

variables.name: Auto-download DLCs
variables.description: Opt-in download of DLCs found in the cached portal response. Upload newly purchased DLC installers manually. Requires AUTO_DOWNLOAD=true.

variables.name: Keep installer files
variables.description: Keep local installation media for reinstalls without another download. Requires sufficient disk space.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the multiplayer server browser. Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Web portal username
variables.description: Login for the dedicated-server web management portal.

variables.name: Web portal password
variables.description: Required non-default web admin password. Keep private; the web portal uses HTTP.

variables.name: Web portal port
variables.description: Port for the admin web management portal. Used internally to auto-start the game session, so it always works even if not exposed. To reach the portal in your browser, add a second allocation and set this to that allocation's port number (default 7999).

variables.name: In-game admin password
variables.description: Password to authenticate as admin from within the game. Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Game join password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join. Leave empty for an open server. Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Maximum number of simultaneous players (game supports up to 16). Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Map ID
variables.description: Map to load, e.g. MapUS, MapFR, MapAlpine, or a mod map id. Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Server language code (en, de, fr, ...). Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Crossplay allowed
variables.description: Allow crossplay between platforms (true/false). Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Pause if empty
variables.description: Pause behaviour when no players are connected (0 off, 2 default). Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Savegame index
variables.description: Which savegame slot to load/continue (1-based). Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Auto-save interval
variables.description: Auto-save interval in minutes (float, e.g. 180.000000). Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Stats interval
variables.description: Statistics write interval in minutes (float). Initial settings only; subsequent changes belong in the GIANTS web panel.

variables.name: Regenerate game configuration
variables.description: DANGER: true replaces game settings/mod selection from Startup variables at every boot, with backup. Keep false to preserve the GIANTS panel settings.

variables.name: Installer version policy
variables.description: current: keep existing media. latest: fetch the latest installer offered by GIANTS once per refresh ID, keep it in installer/releases, and select it for future fresh installations. Does not upgrade an installed game. Requires AUTO_DOWNLOAD=true.

variables.name: Installer refresh ID
variables.description: Change deliberately (e.g. release-2) to authorize ONE new portal request in latest mode. Never use a timestamp that changes on each boot. Reuse the same value on restarts. Do not change after a failed request merely to retry it.
